blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) from unit tests is the common recipe for post-training code models, but a unit test only asks whether the final program passes. We analyze what this unit-test-only reward teaches a model during debugging and find that, while it raises pass rates, it also teaches the model to edit more and to hallucinate bugs in code that is already correct. We introduce PreciseCoder, a training algorithm that augments the unit-test reward with a signal for semantically verified, localized edits, which correlates with smaller edits and higher pass rates. On 4B, 9B, and 27B models, PreciseCoder reduces the average number of edit lines from 7-15to 3 at a pass rate on par with unit-test-only training. Trained only on single-line bugs, PreciseCoder can generalize to repository-level program repair, where it resolves more issues with smaller patches. Its precision also transfers from weaker to stronger models: given the reasoning trace of a 9B PreciseCoder model, frontier models such as GPT-5.6 Sol and Qwen3.8-Max gain 4.6-12.4 points in edit precision with no additional training. Linguistic analysis of the thinking traces shows that our reward encourages the model to reason about individual lines, name the buggy ones, and form consistent bug hypotheses.
blocks.zh: 从单位测试得到的强化学习(RL)是培训后代码模型的共同配方,但单位测试只询问最终程序是否通过. 我们分析这个单位测试的奖励在调试时教给一个模型的是什么,发现虽然它提高了通过率,但它也教给模型更多的编辑,并在代码中幻觉已经正确的错误. 我们引入了PreciseCoder,一种训练算法,它用信号增强单位测试奖励,用于精密核实的本地化编辑,它与较小的编辑和较高的通过率相关. 在4B,9B,和27B型号上,"精密编码"将编辑行从7-15到3的平均次数以与单位试训相同的通过率降低. 仅被训练于单行臭虫上,PreciseCoder可以被概括到寄存器级程序修复,在那里用更小的补丁解决更多的问题. 其精度也从更弱的模型转移到更强的模型:鉴于9B精密编码器模型的推理痕迹,GPT-5.6 Sol和Qune3.8-Max等前沿模型在编辑精度上获得了4.6-12.4分,没有额外的训练. 对思维痕迹的语言分析表明,我们的奖励鼓励模型对单个行进行推理,命名出buggy行,形成一致的bug假说.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: LLMs are increasingly integrated into programs and workflows because they are trained on vast amounts of code. When a developer hands a model a broken function, they want it to identify and repair the fault without modifying code that is already correct. Yet even frontier LLMs rewrite code that was not broken: on PDB ( Zhu et al., 2026b ) , GPT-5.1-Codex passes 76% of tasks, yet only 40% of the lines it edits are necessary. This over-editing is costly (Figure 1(a) ). Reviewers must inspect every changed line, so the cost of reviewing a repair grows with the size of the edit rather than the size of the bug; even merged pull requests produced by coding agents need human revision 45% of the time ( Watanabe et al., 2025 ) . Rewrites can also introduce behaviors the tests do not cover, so a patch that passes every test can still regress ( Qi et al., 2015 ; Smith et al., 2015 ; Ahmed et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en:
Reinforcement learning from unit tests has become the dominant approach to post-training code models ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Lambert et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025b ) , so we ask whether it is a root cause of over-editing.
We first audit what the unit-test reward teaches by tracking the edit statistics of GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) training rollouts and measuring how each candidate reward term correlates with correctness on the same rollouts.
We find the unit-test reward raises pass rates without restraining unnecessary edits, and as training proceeds it increasingly makes the model hallucinate bugs in code that is already correct (Figure 1(b) ).
Prior work counters over-editing by penalizing edit distance to the reference ( Ke et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026a ) or by imitating minimal patches ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Dai et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) , but edit size is only weakly correlated with passing the tests, so optimizing it trades pass rate for smaller edits.
blocks.zh:
从单位测试中强化学习已成为后培训代码模型的主要取向(郭等,2025;兰伯特等,2024;罗等,2025;杨等,2025b),所以我们问这是否是过度编辑的根本原因.
我们首先通过跟踪GRPO(Shao等,2024年)的编辑统计数据,并衡量每个候选人的奖励期如何与同一推出的正确性相挂钩,来审计单位测试奖励的教训。
我们发现单位测试奖励提高通过率而不限制不必要的编辑, 随着训练的进行,它越来越使模型幻觉错误在代码中已经正确(图1(b)).
之前的工作通过惩罚编辑距离与参考文献(Ke等,2026;Zhu等,2026a)或模仿最小补丁(Yang等,2026;Dai等,2025;Luo等,2026)来反驳过度编辑,但编辑大小与通过测试只有微弱的关联,因此优化其交易小编辑的通过率.

blocks.en:
We propose PreciseCoder , which augments the unit-test reward with the semantically verified precision and recall on edits, combined into an F 1 F_{1} score.
Unlike edit size, this score correlates with both the unit-test outcome and the edit size.
Hence, the two terms can be optimized together, and we normalize them separately inside the group-relative optimizer.
Across Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.6-27B, PreciseCoder raises edit precision by 24–29% over the base models and by 26–35% over unit-test-only GRPO, cuts the average edit size from 7–15 to 3 lines per task, and keeps pass rate on par with unit-test-only GRPO.
The same reward suppresses bug hallucination although training never shows a correct program: on correct code input, the no-edit (i.e., no operation) rate rises to 47–52%, against 31–37% for the base models and 19–31% after unit-test-only GRPO.
blocks.zh:
我们提议精确编码器, 增加单位测试的奖励, 精度和编辑时的召回,
与编辑大小不同,此分数与单位测试结果和编辑大小都相关.
因此,这两个术语可以一起优化,我们将它们在集团关系优化器内部单独正常化.
在Wen3.5-4B、Quen3.5-9B和Quen3.6-27B中,PreciseCoder将编辑精度比基本模型提高24-29%,比单位测试唯一的GRPO提高26-35%,将平均编辑大小从每个任务7-15行减少到3行,并使通过率与单位测试唯一的GRPO持平。
同样的奖励抑制了bug的幻觉,尽管训练从来没有显示一个正确的程序:在正确的代码输入上,不编辑(即不操作)的速率会上升到47–52 %,而基本模型的速率是31–37%,单单元测试后的GRPO为19–31%.

blocks.en:
Trained only on single-file single-line bugs, the learned behavior generalizes to complex program repairs.
On PDB-Wild multi-line and repository-level bugs, precision rises by 20, 17 and 20 points at 4B, 9B and 27B while the edit size shrinks by 63–71%.
On SWE-Bench Verified, PreciseCoder resolves more issues without inflating its patches, and it breaks fewer repositories whose issue is already fixed.
Trained with agentic RL in a five-turn editing agent, a 9B model reaches 67.4% edit precision at a 56.3% pass rate, the best of every 9B model in agentic debugging on both.
blocks.zh:
仅被训练在单文件单行错误上,所学的行为被概括到复杂的程序修复上.
在PDB-Wild多行和寄存器级的bug上,精度在4B,9B和27B上分别上升了20,17和20分,而编辑大小则缩小了63-71%.
在SWE-Bench Verifed上,PreciseCoder在不夸大其补丁的情况下解决了更多的问题,并打破了已经解决了问题的较少寄存器.
9B型机车在5个回合的编辑代理中以代理RL进行训练,以56.3%的通过率达到67.4%的编辑精度,是两款机车的代理调试中每9B型机车中最好的.

blocks.en: Precise debugging also transfers upward, to models we cannot train. Handing the reasoning trace of PreciseCoder -9B to five stronger receivers, among them GPT-5.6 Sol and Qwen3.8-Max, raises their edit precision by 4.6–12.4 points at their own pass rates, with no weight access, shared tokenizer or training. A linguistic analysis of the traces points to what travels: either reward makes the model think longer and quote the buggy lines, but only PreciseCoder encourages the model to reason about individual lines, form bug hypotheses, and weigh whether each edit is worth keeping.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: 1 Diagnosis. We show that unit-test-based reinforcement learning raises pass rates while increasing edit size, rewriting correct code, and hallucinating bugs in bug-free programs. We establish this by auditing edit statistics throughout training and measuring each reward term’s correlation with correctness and with the number of edited lines when the unit tests pass. 2 Fix. We augment the unit-test reward with semantically verified precision and recall. Across 4B, 9B, and 27B models, this reward trains stably, raises edit precision by 24–29 points, reduces the average number of edited lines to approximately three per task without sacrificing pass rate, and curbs bug hallucination, raising the no-edit rate on correct code from 31–37% to 47–52%. 3 Generalization. The precision carries to multi-line, repository-level and agentic debugging and to SWE-bench Verified, and it travels through the reasoning trace alone: a 9B donor raises the edit precision of frontier models by 4.6–12.4 points. What travels, per a linguistic analysis of the traces, is naming the buggy line and weighing each edit.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: We review prior work and establish PreciseCoder as the first approach to incorporate semantically verified, localized edits into RL training for generalizable debugging fidelity (see Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们审查以前的工作,并设立精密编码器,作为将经过精密核实的本地化编辑纳入一般调试忠诚度RL培训的第一种方法(见表1)。

blocks.en:
Large language models have become widely used coding tools ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2022 ) , while agents built on them can resolve real-world repository issues ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024a ) .
A common post-training recipe reported by leading AI labs is reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, using unit-test outcomes as the sole reward signal ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Lambert et al., 2024 ; Pan et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025b ) .
However, the program-repair literature has long established that test-passing patches can overfit ( Smith et al., 2015 ; Tan et al., 2016 ) .
Such test overfitting persists in frontier LLMs ( Zhu et al., 2026b ; Ahmed et al., 2025 ) , and functional correctness alone fails to capture many qualities developers value ( Singhal et al., 2024 ; Zhong et al., 2026 ) .
Moreover, LLM code reviewers often hallucinate bugs ( McAleese et al., 2024 ) , prompting unnecessary changes to already-correct programs ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Qu et al., 2026 ) .
By analyzing training dynamics, we identify unit-test-only rewards as the root cause of both behaviors throughout RL training.
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型已被广泛使用编码工具(Chen等,2021;Li等,2022),而在其上所建的代理可以解决现实世界的寄存地问题(Jimenez等,2024;Yang等,2024a.).
主要AI实验室报告的一种常见的训练后配方是强化学习,可核查奖励,将单位测试结果作为唯一的奖励信号(Guo等,2025;Lambert等,2024;Pan等,2025;Yang等,2025a;Loo等,2025;Yang等,2025b).
然而,程序-修复文献早已确定测试-通过补丁可以过度适应(Smith等,2015;Tan等,2016.
在前沿有限责任公司(Zhu等人,2026年b;Ahmed等人,2025年b)中,这种过于匹配的测试持续存在,单靠功能正确性无法捕捉到许多质量开发者的价值(Singhal等人,2024年;Zhong等人,2026年)。
此外,LLM代码审查员经常会幻觉出虫(McAleese等,2024年),促使对已经正确的程序进行不必要的修改(Huang等,2024年;Qu等,2026年).
通过分析训练动态,我们确定单位测试唯一的奖励是整个RL训练中这两种行为的根本原因.

blocks.en:
Existing approaches to reducing over-editing share a common design: rewarding smaller edits.
One line of work optimizes edit size alongside functional correctness.
For example, EA-GRPO subtracts a standardized edited-line penalty from the correctness reward ( Ke et al., 2026 ) , and Zhu et al. (2026a) subtract excess Levenshtein distance to the reference from an execution reward.
Another line of work separates localization from correction.
RECAP trains a post-hoc refiner using supervised fine-tuning and DPO to shrink generated patches ( Luo et al., 2026 ) , whereas localization-first pipelines constrain where the model can edit ( Xia et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025b ) .
However, edit-size-based rewards can be difficult to optimize and may trade test-passing performance for debugging fidelity.
We instead use semantically verified edit size, enabling smoother convergence and better generalization.
blocks.zh:
现有减少过度编辑的方法共享了共同的设计:奖励更小的编辑.
一行工作在功能正确的同时优化了编辑大小.
例如,EA-GRPO从正确性奖励(Ke等,2026年)中减去了被编辑的标准化行处罚(Zhu等. (2026a) 从执行奖励中将多余的列文斯提因距离减去引用.
另一行工作将本地化与校正区分开来.
RECAP使用有监督的微调和DPO来培训后热精炼器以收缩生成的补丁(Luo等,2026年),而本地化-第一管道则制约了模型可以编辑的地方(Xia等,2024年;Chen等,2025年;Yang等,2025年b).
然而,基于编辑大小的奖励可能难以优化,并可能以测试通过性能换取调试忠诚.
相反,我们使用经过详细核实的编辑大小,从而能够更平稳地趋同,更好地概括。

blocks.en: 3.1 Fidelity Concerns with Unit-Test-Only GRPO
blocks.zh: 3.1 与单位试验有关的 " Fidelity " 问题

blocks.en: We first train Qwen3.5-4B with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO, Shao et al., 2024 ) using the reward r = T ⁡ ( C ^ ) r=T(\hat{C}) on PDB ( Zhu et al., 2026b ) tasks, and analyze the training dynamics.

blocks.en:
As shown by the gray line in Figure 1(b) (left and middle), the model initially learns to repair programs by editing more: the mean number of edited lines tracks the pass rate, with both rising over steps 0–50 and 100–150 and falling over steps 50–100.
Once the pass rate begins to plateau, however, the reward continues to periodically encourage over-editing, and the mean edit size grows from 3.94 to 8.28 lines on the training set.
blocks.zh:
如图1(b)(左下同中)灰色行所示,该模型最初通过编辑更多来学习修复程序:被编辑的行的平均数跟踪通过率,在0-50和100-150两个步骤之间均上升,在50-100步之间下降.
然而,一旦通过率开始趋于平稳,奖励继续定期鼓励过度编辑,平均编辑大小从3.94行增加到8.28行。

blocks.en:
Training never shows the model a correct program, yet the effect of the reward on correct programs is measurable.
On a validation set of 200 bug-free programs, the unit-test-only reward teaches the model to hallucinate bugs and modify correct code: the no-op rate on ground-truth programs drops from 30.8% at the start of training to 20.5% averaged over the last three evaluations (Figure 1(b) , right).
blocks.zh:
培训从未向模型显示一个正确的方案,然而奖励对正确的方案的影响是可衡量的。
在200个无臭虫程序的验证集中,单位测试的奖励只教该模型产生幻觉出臭虫并修改正确的代码:地面真实程序的不开放率从培训开始时的30.8%下降到过去三次评价的平均20.5%(图1(b),右侧).

blocks.en: 3.2 How Different Reward Terms Correlate
blocks.zh: 3.2 不同奖励术语如何相互关联

blocks.en:
Next, we analyze how candidate reward components correlate with one another on the Qwen3.5-4B and 9B base models (Figure 2 ).
Existing methods such as EA-GRPO use linear or gated combinations of the pass indicator unit = T ⁡ ( C ^ ) \mathrm{unit}=T(\hat{C}) and the edit size ℓ \ell .
However, the Pearson correlation between − ℓ -\ell and unit \mathrm{unit} is low, at 0.13 0.13 on 4B and 0.14 0.14 on 9B: edit size carries little information about correctness, so optimizing it directly can destabilize training and degrade the pass rate.
blocks.zh:
其次,我们分析候选人奖赏部分在Quen3.5-4B和9B基准模型(图2)上如何相互联系。
EA-GRPO等现有方法使用线性或有门的组合通过指标单位=T → (C ^)\mathrm{unit {T (\hat{C})和编辑大小为l\ell.
然而,-l-\ell与单位\mathrm{unit}之间的皮尔逊关联度较低,4B的0.130.13和9B的0.140.14:编辑大小携带的正确性信息很少,因此优化可以直接破坏训练,并降低通过率.

blocks.en:
To address this, we introduce semantically verified, localized edit rewards.
Inspired by Zhu et al. (2026b) , we score the edit fault by fault: each predicted block δ ^ i ⊆ Δ ^ \hat{\delta}_{i}\subseteq\hat{\Delta} is aligned to a reference block δ i ⋆ ⊆ Δ ⋆ \delta^{\star}_{i}\subseteq\Delta^{\star} , and the model is credited with fault i i ( fix i = 1 \mathrm{fix}_{i}=1 ) iff the program under the counterfactual edit Δ = Δ ⋆ − { δ i ⋆ } ∪ { δ ^ i } \Delta=\Delta^{\star}-\{\delta_{i}^{\star}\}\cup\{\hat{\delta}_{i}\} passes the tests.
Precision and recall are then rec = 1 m ​ ∑ i fix i ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] , prec = 1 ℓ ​ ∑ i fix i ​ min ⁡ ( | ess i | , | δ i ⋆ | + ϵ ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] , \mathrm{rec}=\tfrac{1}{m}\textstyle\sum_{i}\mathrm{fix}_{i}\in[0,1],\qquad\mathrm{prec}=\tfrac{1}{\ell}\textstyle\sum_{i}\mathrm{fix}_{i}\,\min\!\big(|\mathrm{ess}_{i}|,\,|\delta^{\star}_{i}|+\epsilon\big)\in[0,1], (1) where m m is the number of reference faults, ess i ⊆ δ ^ i \mathrm{ess}_{i}\subseteq\hat{\delta}_{i} is the smallest subset of the predicted block that still repairs fault i i , and ϵ \epsilon tolerates a few extra lines per fault.
Recall asks which faults were repaired; precision asks what fraction of the edited lines were needed to repair them.

We evaluate each candidate reward term by two metrics: its correlation with unit \mathrm{unit} , for stability , and its correlation with − ℓ -\ell among passing samples, for fidelity (Figure 2 ). − ℓ -\ell fails the first, and unit \mathrm{unit} , constant among passing samples, fails the second. prec \mathrm{prec} correlates well with − ℓ -\ell (> 0.81 0.81 ), while rec \mathrm{rec} correlates well with unit \mathrm{unit} (> 0.71 0.71 ).
We therefore design a reward of the form r = f ⁡ ( unit , prec , rec ) r=f(\mathrm{unit},\mathrm{prec},\mathrm{rec}) .

因此,我们设计了 r = f = (单位, prec, rec) r = f (\ mathrm{unit},\ mathrm{ prec},\ mathrm{rec} 的奖励 。

First, to avoid spurious block misalignment, we gate rec \mathrm{rec} on unit \mathrm{unit} : we define rec ~ = 1 \widetilde{\mathrm{rec}}=1 if unit = 1 \mathrm{unit}=1 and rec ~ = rec \widetilde{\mathrm{rec}}=\mathrm{rec} otherwise, since a passing program has by definition resolved every injected fault.

blocks.en: 3.3 Algorithm
blocks.zh: 3.3 算术

blocks.en:
We propose PreciseCoder , which trains with the reward r λ = ( 1 − λ ) ​ unit + λ ​ F 1 r_{\lambda}=(1-\lambda)\,\mathrm{unit}+\lambda\,F_{1} .
Note that GRPO standardizes rewards within each group.
Applied to the sum r λ r_{\lambda} , this standardization collapses to the standardized F 1 F_{1} in any group where unit \mathrm{unit} is constant, so the weight λ \lambda acts unevenly across groups ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Ichihara et al., 2025 ) .
To mitigate this, we use GDPO ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , which standardizes each term within the group before mixing, followed by batch-level rescaling.
Under this normalization, a passing correction retains a larger advantage than a failing one whenever λ < 2 / ( 2 + 2 ​ G ) \lambda<2/(2+\sqrt{2G}) , i.e., λ < 0.37 \lambda<0.37 at G = 6 G=6 (Appendix A.1 ); we use λ = 1 / 3 \lambda=1/3 .
Within this range, the exact value of λ \lambda matters little: where unit \mathrm{unit} is constant the advantage equals the standardized F 1 F_{1} regardless of λ \lambda , and elsewhere F 1 F_{1} only breaks ties.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en:
We train on 5,274 tasks from PDB-Single-Full ( Zhu et al., 2026b ) , the unfiltered pool of 7,589 synthesized single-line-bug programs built on BigCodeBench ( Zhuo et al., 2025 ) and LiveCodeBench ( Jain et al., 2025 ) problems.
We test on 1,205 held-out tasks from PDB-Single, the verified subset of this pool. The test problems share no base problem with any training task.
We evaluate on unit test passing rate, precision, recall, and edited lines.
blocks.zh:
我们从PDB-Single-Full(Zhu等,2026b.),7,589个未过滤的单行-bug程序,在BigCode Bench(Zhuo等,2025年)和LiveCode Bench(Jain等,2025年)问题的基础上,进行了5,274项任务的培训。
我们测试了来自PDB-Single的1,205个被搁置的任务,这个集合中已经核实的子集. 测试问题与任何培训任务没有基本问题。
我们评估单位测试通过率、精确度、召回率和编辑线。

blocks.en:
In addition, we also test bug hallucination by asking LLMs to fix 1,512 ground truth programs, drawn from BigCodeBench and LiveCodeBench problems that do not appear in the above splits.
We evaluate on no operation rate (No-op%) and damage rate (i.e., test failure rate) from the output.
blocks.zh:
此外,我们还通过要求LLMs修复从BigCode Bench和LiveCode Bench问题中抽取的1,512个地面真理程序来测试bug幻觉,这些问题没有出现在上述分出.
我们评价产出的无操作率(无操作率)和损坏率(即测试故障率)。

blocks.en:
We use Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) and Qwen3.6-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) as the backbone models, and compare with five baselines: (1) SFT : supervised fine-tuning with rejection-sampling ( Zhu et al., 2026a ) , (2) DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) , (3): GRPO : unit-test-only GRPO, (4) RECAP : training a post-hoc edit size refiner after correction ( Luo et al., 2026 ) , and (5) EA-GRPO : penalizing edit size in mostly-passing groups ( Ke et al., 2026 ) .
We further compare with four frontier models: GPT-5.6 Sol ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , DeepSeek-V4-Pro ( DeepSeek-AI and others, 2026b ) , DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ( DeepSeek-AI and others, 2026a ) and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next ( Qiu et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Compared with GRPO in Table 2 , RECAP and EA-GRPO substantially improve fidelity on Qwen3.5-4B: mean edited lines drop from 13.8 to at most 3.7, and precision rises from 30% to over 58%.
However, this comes at the cost of pass rate, which falls from 55.1% to 38.1% for RECAP and 53.3% for EA-GRPO.
The same pattern holds on Qwen3.5-9B.
This is consistent with our earlier analysis: because edit size is only weakly correlated with pass rate, optimizing it directly incurs a performance trade-off.
blocks.zh:
与表2中的GRPO相比,RECAP和EA-GRPO大幅提高了Quen3.5-4B的忠诚度:经编辑的正线从13.8条下降到了最多3.7条,精度从30%上升到了58%以上。
不过,这是以通过率为代价的,通过率从55.1%降至38.1%,而通过率则从53.3%降至欧援署。
同样的图案在Quen3.5-9B上保持.
这与我们先前的分析是一致的:因为编辑大小仅与通过率有微弱的关联,优化它直接导致性能取舍.

blocks.en:
Table 2 reports the mean and standard deviation of PreciseCoder over 3 runs.
Unlike prior methods, PreciseCoder reduces mean edited lines from 13.8 to 3.0 on Qwen3.5-4B while keeping pass rate on par with GRPO; the same holds on Qwen3.5-9B. PreciseCoder ranks in the top two on every metric, demonstrating its robustness and validating a reward design that balances stability and effectiveness.
blocks.zh:
表2报告了精密编码器在3次运行中的平均和标准的偏差。
与以前的方法不同,精密编码器将Quen3.5-4B上的被编辑的行从13.8减少到了3.0,同时保持了与GRPO相同的通过率;而Quen3.5-9B上的通过率不变. 精确编码器在每个度量衡中排在前2位,显示了它的稳健性并验证了平衡稳定性和有效性的奖励设计.

blocks.en:
PreciseCoder on Qwen3.6-27B outperforms its GRPO counterpart, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on all measures.
GPT-5.6 Sol attains the highest pass rate (86.1%) but still over-edits: its precision is 17.7% below PreciseCoder (79.2%), and it edits 1.5 more lines on average than PreciseCoder (2.6).
This suggests PreciseCoder could surpass frontier models when scaled to comparable size.
blocks.zh:
Qwen3.6-27B上的精密编码器超越了GRPO的对应器DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash和Qune3.8-Flash-Next在所有措施上.
GPT-5.6 常规 索尔达到最高的通过率(86.1%),但仍过于编辑:其精度低于"精密编码"(PreciseCoder)(79.2%),平均比"精密编码"(PreciseCoder (2.6)多编辑了1.5行.
这说明 精确编码器在缩小到可比规模时可以超越前沿模型。

blocks.en: 4.3 Bug Hallucination on Correct Code
blocks.zh: 4.3 正确代码上的臭虫幻觉

blocks.en:
No training row contains correct code and no reward term rewards a no-op, yet restraint against bug hallucination comes for free.
In Table 2 , unit-test-only GRPO lowers the no-op rate from 30.6% to 19.3% at 4B, from 36.6% to 30.7% at 9B and from 31.1% to 26.9% at 27B, whereas PreciseCoder raises it to 48.0%, 51.6% and 45.8% and breaks fewer correct programs than the base model (damage 13.5%, 11.8% and 11.1% vs. 19.3%, 18.7% and 15.5%).
RECAP’s refiner and EA-GRPO’s size penalty show similar but smaller gains.
Moreover, we show in Appendix B.4 that PreciseCoder keeps its advantage on the GT debugging tasks when prompting for restraint ( Gloaguen et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
没有训练排包含正确的代码,没有奖励期奖励 一个不op,但克制虫幻术是免费的。
在表2中,单测试的GRPO将4B的不开放率从30.6%降至19.3%,9B的不开放率从36.6%降至30.7%,27B的不开放率从31.1%降至26.9%,而精密编码器将其提高到48.0%、51.6%和45.8%,并打破的正确方案比基准模型少(损害13.5%、11.8%和11.1%对19.3%、18.7%和15.5%)。
RECAP的炼油厂和EA-GRPO的尺寸处罚显示类似但较小的收益.
此外,我们在附录B.4中显示,PreciseCoder在催促克制时保持其在GT调试任务的优势(Gloaguen等,2026年).

blocks.en:
Plotting the no-op rates in Table 2 against edit precision, we find a near-linear relationship (Figure 3 ).
The two skills are highly correlated, with r = 0.87 r=0.87 across all 4B–27B models ( r = 0.94 r=0.94 within the 4B rows and 0.92 0.92 within the 9B rows).
Conversely, training on a mixture that includes ground-truth debugging tasks also improves debugging fidelity (Appendix B.1 ).
Either skill thus brings the other along for free.

根据编辑精度绘制表2中的无线速率,我们发现近线性关系(图3 )。
这两种技能密切相关,所有4B-27B型号的r=0.87 r=0.87(r=0.94 r=0.94 在4B行和9B行内0.92 0.92).
反之,关于包括地面-真实调试任务的混合物的培训也改善了调试忠诚度(附录B.1)。
任何一种技能都会免费带来另一种技能。

Table 3 trains Qwen3.5-4B on each reward term alone and in combination.
With the unit test alone, the policy passes 55.1% of tasks but edits 13.8 lines per task at 30.0% precision.

blocks.en: 5 Generalization
blocks.zh: 5 概况

blocks.en:
Training shows PreciseCoder only single-line faults in single-file programs, repaired in one shot.
We test whether the learned precision survives settings that training never shows, whether it reaches stronger models through the reasoning trace alone, and what the reward changed in that trace.
blocks.zh:
训练显示PreciseCoder在单文件程序中只出现单行断层,一次被修复.
我们测试所学的精度是否在训练从未显示的环境下存活下来,它是否仅通过推理追踪就能达到更强的模型,以及奖励在这种追踪中有什么变化。

blocks.en: 5.1 Generalization to Complex Program Repairs
blocks.zh: 5.1 向复杂方案修理的通用

blocks.en:
On PDB-Wild ( Zhu et al., 2026b ) , 484 multi-line and repository-level tasks drawn from BigCodeBench, LiveCodeBench and SWE-smith ( Yang et al., 2025a ) , PreciseCoder raises edit precision over the base model by 20.3, 16.7 and 20.2 points at 4B, 9B and 27B, and pass rate by 10–13 points at every size (Figure 4 ).
The mean edit shrinks from 37.8 to 10.8 lines at 4B, from 33.9 to 12.0 at 9B and from 18.4 to 6.8 at 27B. PreciseCoder outperforms EA-GRPO across all sizes in both unit test pass rate and precision.
On PDB-Wild, unit-test-only GRPO shows no improvement in precision either, changing it by − 2.7 -2.7 , + 0.1 +0.1 and − 9.0 -9.0 points against the base model at 4B, 9B and 27B.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: 5.2 Weak-to-Strong Transfer
blocks.zh: 5.2 弱变速转移

blocks.en:
Reasoning can move between models without their weights: weak-to-strong generalization elicits a strong model’s capability from a weaker supervisor ( Burns et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024b ) , advisor models steer a black-box model with natural-language advice ( Asawa et al., 2026 ) , and Cheng et al. (2026) prefill one model’s chain of thought into another.
We ask whether an editing discipline, rather than a capability, travels this way from a small trained model to frontier models that already exceed it on correctness.
A trained PreciseCoder model, the donor , thinks about a task; we prefill its think block, token for token, into the assistant turn of an untrained receiver over a raw completions endpoint, and the receiver writes the repair, either closing the think block at once or continuing to think from its end.
No weights, tokenizer or training are shared.
blocks.zh:
理性可以在模型之间移动而不用其分量:弱到强的通化从一个较弱的上司那里引出强的模型能力(Burns等,2024;Yang等,2024b),顾问模型用自然语言的建议引导黑盒模型(Asawa等,2026),程等(2026)将一个模型的思维链预先排入另一个模型.
我们问,编辑学科,而不是能力,是否通过这种方式从一个受过训练的小型模型到在正确性上已经超过它的前沿模型。
一个训练有素的精密编码模型,捐赠者,想着一个任务; 我们把它的思维块,象征性地装入一个未经训练的接收器的助手转弯, 在一个原始的完成点上, 接收者写作修复, 要么立刻关闭思维块, 要么继续从它的结尾思考。

With no weights changed, the think block alone moves the base model most of the way toward the trained model on both axes.

blocks.en: 5.3 What Changed in the Thinking

blocks.en: To see what the block carries, we analyze the complete chains of thought on PDB Test of the 4B and 9B base, unit-test-only GRPO and PreciseCoder models, and of two frontier models whose traces are readable, GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek-V4-Pro, on the lexical categories, distinctive bigrams by weighted log-odds, and verbatim matches of the buggy lines (details in Appendix B.6 ).

blocks.en:
Under either reward the 9B thinks to the 4,096-token budget, quotes code inline half again as often (170 and 168 spans per 1,000 words against 111) and backtracks more (“wait” 12.3 and 15.2 per 1,000 words against 6.1; see Appendix Figure 10 ).
What only the precision reward adds is judgement : PreciseCoder -9B hedges more than unit-test-only GRPO (10.8 against 6.5 per 1,000 words: “might be”, “I think”, “I’ll assume”), echoes the instructions half as often (3.4 against 6.5) and almost never argues from the prompt that a bug must exist (0.04 against 0.59). PreciseCoder ’s distinctive bigrams are “might be”, “is valid” and “keep the”, weighing whether a line is worth keeping, while GRPO’s are “let’s check”, “only fix” and “make minimal”, restating the instruction to fix.

只有精确的奖励才有判断: 精确编码器 -9B套期超过单位试运行的GRPO(10.8对6.5对千字:"可能","我想","我假设"),重复了指令的一半频率(3.4对6.5),并且几乎从来没有从提示中论证必须存在一个bug(0.04对0.59). 精确编码器独特的大调是 " 可能 " 、 " 有效 " 和 " 保持 " 、权衡一条线是否值得保留,而GRPO是 " 让我们检查 " 、 " 只固定 " 和 " 尽量少 " ,重述要修正的指示。

The share of tasks on which the thinking names every buggy line verbatim rises from 36% to 67% at 4B and from 43% to 71% at 9B under PreciseCoder .
Within each of the eight models in Figure 8 , recall is 4–19% higher on the tasks whose thinking quotes every buggy line.
Holding the model fixed, one standard deviation more of quoting is worth +4.3 F 1 F_{1} and +3.2 precision points.

blocks.en:
Frontier models have different own thinking patterns, which hinder the effectiveness of SFT training before RL.
GLM-5.2 talks to itself in the first person and DeepSeek-V4-Pro thinks in questions, whereas the trained models think in identifier-anchored conditionals (“ x is”, “if x ”, “ x returns” for a quoted identifier x ; see Appendix Table 9 ).
The receivers of Table 4 thus gain precision from a block written in a style unlike their own; what they take from it, we hypothesize, is the line it names and the verdict it reaches on each edit.
blocks.zh:
边疆模型有自己的不同的思维模式,这阻碍了SFT训练在RL之前的有效性.
GLM-5.2首先自言自语,DeepSeek-V4-Pro则在问题中思考,而训练有素的模型则在识别符号附加条件中思考(“x是”、“if x ”、“x 返回”引用的识别符号x;见附录表9)。
因此,表4的接收者从不同于他们自己风格的块中获得精确度;我们假设,它们从中提取的是它命名的行和它在每个编辑上达到的判断。

blocks.en:
On the 1,512 correct programs of GT Debug, every model asserts that the code “looks correct” at the same rate (8–11 times per 1,000 words); what differs is what it does next. PreciseCoder -9B proposes 27.6 bug hypotheses per 1,000 words against 4.7 for its base and 10.8 for unit-test-only GRPO, and its no-op rate rises from 21% to 68% between the quarter of tasks with the fewest hypotheses and the quarter with the most, whereas the 9B unit-test-only model stays near 30%, as shown in Figure 8 .
Every trained model edits 85–99% of the clean programs on which its thinking confidently stops before the 16k-token budget.
The precision reward does not teach the model to declare a program correct early; it teaches it to keep testing candidate bugs and, finding none it trusts, to return the code unchanged.

在GT调试的1,512个正确程序上,每个模型都声称代码"看起来正确"以相同的速度(每1,000个字8-11倍);它接下来做什么就不同了. 精确编码器 -9B提出每千字有27.6个bug假说,而其基数为4.7个bug假说,而单位测试唯一的GRPO为10.8个bug假说,其无操作率在任务季度间从21%上升至68%,其中假设最少的季度为68%,而如图8所显示的,9B单位测试唯一的模型保持了近30%.
每个训练有素的模型都会编辑85%到99%的清洁程序,在16k-token预算之前,它的思考就自信地停止了。
精密奖励并不教模型提早宣布程序正确;它教模型不断测试候选错误,并且发现没有它信任的,返回代码不变.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
A unit-test reward scores the program a model returns, not the edit that produced it, so RL from unit tests raises pass rates while letting edits grow and teaching the model to invent bugs in correct code. PreciseCoder makes the reward see the edit through semantically verified precision and recall: it improves debugging fidelity and keeps unit-test pass rate on-par with standard training.
The learned precision is not tied to the training distribution: it carries to multi-line and repository-level faults, to SWE-bench Verified, where PreciseCoder resolves more issues with smaller patches and breaks fewer already-fixed repositories.
Most importantly, it travels without weights: the think block of a 9B PreciseCoder model raises the edit precision of frontier models such as GPT-5.6 Sol.
Since the trained model thinks nothing like its receivers, we attribute the transfer to what the block does rather than how it sounds: it names the buggy line and weighs whether each edit is worth keeping.
blocks.zh:
一个单位测试的奖励给程序评分一个模型返回,而不是生成它的编辑,因此单位测试的RL提高了通过率,同时让编辑增长,并教模型在正确的代码中发明错误. 精准编码器使奖励通过精准的精度和回想看到编辑:它提高了调试忠诚度并保持单位测试通过率,同时进行标准训练.
所学得的精度与训练分发不挂钩:它携带多行和寄存层断层,到SWE-bench Verifed,其中PreciseCoder用更小的补丁解决更多的问题并打破已经固定的寄存层.
最重要的是,它的行走没有重量:9B PreciseCoder模型的思想块提高了GPT-5.6 Sol等前沿模型的编辑精度.
由于受过训练的模型并不认为它像接收器一样,所以我们把传输归结为区块的工作,而不是它的声音:它命名了buggy行并权衡每个编辑是否值得保留.

blocks.en:
The idea is not specific to debugging: the reward credits an action only when it is checked against a reference and verified to do the work the reference requires, so a correct but unnecessary action earns nothing.
In long-horizon agentic tasks, where each unneeded action is a chance to break something, such a reward could serve both performance and safety by penalizing side effects that an outcome-only reward cannot see; the lower damage of PreciseCoder -27B on already-fixed repositories is a first sign, and defining the reference there is left to future work.
blocks.zh:
这个想法并不是特地去调试的:奖励只有在对照一个参考物进行检查并核实完成参考物所要求的工作时才能抵免一个动作,所以一个正确而不必要的动作一无所获.
在长距离代理任务中,每一次不需要的行动都是破解某事的机会,这种奖赏可以通过惩罚只见结果的奖赏所看不到的副作用,为业绩和安全服务;PreciseCoder -27B在已经固定的寄存器上受到的更低的破坏是第一个标志,并定义了未来工作的参考。

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
This work trains language models to repair bugs in code with minimal edits. It
involves no human subjects, and uses only publicly released datasets and
benchmarks and open-weight models under their respective licenses. All model-generated code is executed in a sandbox during training and
evaluation. Better automated debugging could lower the cost of maintaining
software. Like any code model, it could also be misused or produce subtly wrong
fixes, and precise minimal edits may make such errors harder to spot in review; we
therefore recommend human review of model-proposed patches. We are not aware of
any conflicts of interest.

blocks.en: B.4 Prompting analysis on GT Debug Task

blocks.en:
Gloaguen et al. (2026) show that an abstain-or-fix prompt reduces edits when a coding agent is given already-correct code.
We test such a prompt on GT Debug (Table 7 , Appendix D.3 ): it asks the model to check whether the code has a bug and to return it unchanged if not.
The prompt helps every model: each raises its no-op rate by 14 to 44 points and lowers its damage rate.
Base models gain the most (34–44 points of no-op), with frontier models close behind (27–34).
Unit-test-only GRPO remains the least restrained model at 4B and 9B (51.4% and 51.5% no-op), and at 27B it falls below its own base model (67.9% vs. 75.5%). PreciseCoder beats the base model and EA-GRPO on both rates at 4B and 9B, beats frontier models at 27B, and narrows the gap to runs trained on clean rows: from 25.7 to 11.3 no-op points at 4B and from 20.2 to 4.3 at 9B, where its damage (7.4%) falls below theirs (8.0%).

blocks.en:
We analyze the complete think blocks of the six local models of Table 2 on the 1,205 PDB Test tasks and the 1,512 GT Debug programs, and of GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek-V4-Pro on PDB Test, one sample per task at temperature 0.6 under the minimal-edit prompt.
The local models think for at most 4,096 tokens on PDB Test and 16,384 on GT Debug and the frontier APIs for 16k–32k, so every lexical measure is a rate per 1,000 prose words, the block with fenced code removed and inline code spans replaced by a placeholder, and length is reported on its own.

blocks.en:
We count 15 hand-built, case-insensitive lexical categories, among them backtracking (“wait”, “actually”), hedging (“might be”, “I think”, “I’ll assume”), verification, minimal-edit talk, instruction echo, “looks correct” assertions, “the prompt says there is a bug” and bug hypotheses (“maybe the bug is”, “I found it”), plus lexical diversity (moving-average type–token ratio, Covington and McFall, 2010 ) and repetition.
Distinctive bigrams are ranked by the weighted log-odds ratio with an informative Dirichlet prior ( Monroe et al., 2008 ) , and vocabularies are compared by the Jensen–Shannon divergence of their unigram distributions.

与众不同的大字节按加权对数比和资料丰富的Dirichlet(Monroe等,2008年)排列,词汇按其单格分布的Jensen-Shannon差异进行比较。

RECAP ( Luo et al., 2026 ) repairs in two stages: a generator proposes a fix, and a separately trained refiner
rewrites it into a correct, minimal patch. We use each base model as its own generator and fine-tune the

from the 4B or 9B base model on a PDB training task; targets are a correct minimal fix, either the
ground-truth solution or the most precise passing sample. The training set mixes three cases in a 3 : 1 : 1 3{:}1{:}1 ratio: a correct but over-edited candidate that must be trimmed (correct → \to correct), an
incorrect candidate that must be repaired (incorrect → \to correct), and a candidate that is already a
correct minimal fix and must be returned as is. Each target is paired with a reasoning trace generated by
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash ( DeepSeek-AI and others, 2026a ) , and the 3,761 examples that pass every filter
(3,381 train, 380 validation) are used to fine-tune for six epochs. We also trained the refiner with DPO,
on on-policy pairs and on pairs built from DeepSeek outputs, but neither improved on SFT, so we report the
SFT refiner. At evaluation the refiner takes the same-size base model’s one-shot output on each task as its
candidate and answers under the refine prompt of Appendix D.2 .

blocks.en:
The benchmarks we build on are Python: we train on
PDB tasks derived from BigCodeBench and LiveCodeBench and evaluate on these, on SWE-smith repositories
(PDB-Wild), SWE-bench Verified, HumanEval+, CruxEval and the Python subset of DebugBench. Nothing in the
reward is specific to Python: precision and recall are computed on line-level diffs against a reference fix,
and semantic verification only executes the tests. Extending PreciseCoder to another language therefore requires
buggy programs with reference fixes and a test harness in that language, such as the C++ and Java splits of
DebugBench ( Tian et al., 2024 ) , rather than a change to the method; we have not run this experiment.
blocks.zh:
我们建立的基准是Python:我们训练在
从 BigCode Bench 和 LiveCode Bench 衍生出来的 PDB 任务,并在 SWE 史密斯存储器上对此进行评价
(PDB-Wild), SWE-bench 验证,HumanEval+,CruxEval和除虫Bench的Python子集. 什么都没有
奖励是针对Python的:精确度和召回度是用线级差分比照参考定律计算的,
和语义验证只执行测试。 因此,将精密编码器扩展至另一种语言需要
buggy程序具有参考修正和该语言的测试带,例如 C++ 和 Java 分割
Debug Bench (Tian等, 2024), 而不是改变方法; 我们没有运行这个实验.

blocks.en:
Precision and recall are measured against a
ground-truth fix (Section 3.2 ), so every training task needs one. The reference can come
from the benchmark itself, as in PDB; from a human-written fix, such as the developer patches of
SWE-bench Verified ( OpenAI, 2024 ) ; or, where neither exists, from a model-generated fix that
passes the unit tests.
blocks.zh:
精确度和召回度与
地面真相修复(第3.2节),因此每项培训任务都需要一项。 参考文献可以来
从基准本身,如在PDB中; 从人写定,如开发者补丁
SWE-bench 验证(OpenAI, 2024);或者,如果两者均不存在,则使用模型生成的固定件,
通过单位测试。

blocks.en:
Computing precision and
recall, including the semantic verification of each edit block, adds about
5–7% to the wall-clock time of unit-test-only training. Caching semantic
verification results reduces this cost, and it is amortized further as
training scales to larger groups, longer rollouts or larger models, where
generation and the policy update dominate.

提醒,包括每个编辑块的语义校正,增加关于
5-7%到仅限单位测试的墙上时间。 缓存语义
核查结果减少这一费用,进一步摊还如下:
培训规模扩大到较大的群体、较长的推出时间或更大的模式,其中:
生成和政策的更新占主导地位。
